parameters: "A man who met a rabid dog got so scared,
his clothes turned pure white, meow!"
"Well, there's no need for you to worry.
You're an undead after all...unless something
really terrible happens, you won't disappear."
"That aside...there's not a person in this
world you can talk with normally."
"...I'm fine. I don't mind the heat.
No need to worry about me."
She might die if we have sex in this heat.
